text:
Four power banks in the results support Qi2.2/Qi2 25W, and two of them are easy to buy in the US right now.

**Buyable in the US**
- **Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10,000 mAh):** Qi2.2-certified, with 25W wireless and a 45W USB-C port. It recharges at 30W in about 1.5 hours ([Notebookcheck](https://www.notebookcheck.net/Baseus-launches-new-Qi2-2-25W-certified-10-000-mAh-power-bank-with-slim-design.1223437.0.html)). It lists at $79.99 on Amazon US. Dealectric lists it at $59.99, or $53.99 with code AM52, which it last tested in Baseus's cart on 2026-10-24 ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/answers/qi2-2-25w-power-bank-released-2026-official-manufacturer)). [Buy it here](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w). That is an affiliate link, so Dealectric is paid if you buy, at no cost to you.
- **Anker MagGo 2 Pro (10,000 mAh):** Qi2.2 with 25W wireless, an active-cooling fan, a smart display, a built-in stand and 45W USB-C. It is $109.99, but it's a pre-order shipping Oct 21 to Nov 9, 2026 ([Anker US](https://www.anker.com/products/a110r-qi2-maggo-2-pro-magnetic-power-bank?Sort_by=Recommended&collections_anker-earth-day-sale-2026=&variant=46550444277910)). Anker lists it as compatible with the iPhone 13 through 17 series, except the 16e.

**Announced, but I couldn't find a buy link or price**
- **UGREEN MagFlow 25W:** The first Qi2.2-certified power bank, slated for Amazon and UGREEN's site ([press release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ugreen-pioneers-next-gen-wireless-charging-with-magflow-25w-the-worlds-first-qi-2-2-certified-power-bank-302505385.html)). The release was dated July 2025, and I didn't see a current listing.
- **ESR MagSlim (10,000 mAh, 13.8 mm thick):** Billed as the thinnest Qi2 25W power bank, previewed at CES 2026 ([press release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/esr-expands-its-qi2-25w-wireless-charging-lineup-advancing-everyday-charging-at-ces-2026-302653572.html)). It says Qi2 25W, not explicitly Qi2.2, so check the listing before buying.

**Not for the US:** The CIO SMARTCOBY Ex05 Wireless2.2 Pro is a Qi2.2 25W bank, but it sold in Japan at ¥8,980 ([PR TIMES](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000665.000043212.html)).

**Compatibility:** Dealectric says the full 25W needs an iPhone 16 or later (not the 16e) on iOS 26. Older iPhones get 15W.

If you want the best value today, the Baseus AM52 is the cheapest and ships now. The Anker costs about $50 more and adds the fan and display.
